description.value:
The experimental muscle-weakening neurotoxin coating the blade of this prototype knife is stunningly effective.

Category: Very Expensive • Fabrication: DV24 - 1,000eb - 2 Weeks

Class: Iconic EQ Medium Melee • Skill: Melee Weapons • Range: Melee

Damage: 2d6 • Capacity: N/A • ROF: 2 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: Yes

Slots: N/A • Attachments: None • Mods: None

Special Features: Contains a special cartridge that is pre-loaded with 4 doses of Experimental Neurotoxin (100eb per extra cartridge). While a cartridge is loaded, this weapon deals no damage on an Attack.

Instead, hit meat targets must beat a DV19 Resist Torture/Drugs Check to not be immediately afflicted by the Experimental Neurotoxin. If failed, the victim’s MOVE and DEX ar reduced by 3 (Minimum 0) for the next 3 seconds (1 Round).

If this weapon hits a target’s head via an Aimed Shot, the Resist Torture/Drugs check is increased to DV21, and Experimental Neurotoxin’s effect instead lasts for 6 seconds (2 Rounds). While a cartridge is not loaded, this weapon deals damage like a regular Medium Melee Weapon.

Fabrication: DV24 - 1,000eb - 2 Weeks
Range: Melee

Foundry notes:

  • Listed capacity is N/A; the sheet tracks 0.
  • Iconic weapons follow the Exotic weapon rules: no Non-Basic Ammunition and no Attachment Slots unless this entry says otherwise.
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Very Expensive benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
